slides.texte_overlay:
5 words to help
expand your vocabulary

Vivacious:
lively and full of
charm
(vi-VAY-shuhs)

Example:
Her vivacious laugh made
the whole table smile.

Urbane:
polished, courteous
and refined
(ur-BAYN)

Example:
He was urbane and knew
what to say to everyone.

Droll:
funny in a dry,
unexpected way
(DROHL)

Example:
She made a droll remark
and the room went quiet,
then laughed.

Placid:
calm and not easily
upset
(PLAS-id)

Example:
She stayed placid while
everyone else panicked.

Raconteur:
someone who tells
stories brilliantly
(rak-on-TUR)

Example:
She became a true
raconteur, with a new story
from history or art for
every dinner.
